subject: [PATCH 10/60] sched/numa: restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with memoryless nodes and suggested checking for N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of just N_MEMORY. The patch author's initial message did not elicit any responses or comments.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) migration by restricting the targets of memory migrations to nodes that have common memory. The current implementation checks if a node has any memory, but this can lead to issues where a node has CPUs but no memory, causing faults and failures during migration.
